messages:
maria (sec-oncall): Alert: our audit pipeline flagged ~120 API token creations from service-account 'redwood-data-proc@' across two regions in the last 6m. Possible automated abuse. See alert id: A-2026-892
security-bot: [ALERT] anomalous_iam_activity - 1794501234 - src_ips: [34.86.12.9, 18.197.45.2] - actions: token.create, dataset.export - link: https://alerts.internal/alerts/A-2026-892
alex (incident-cmdr): I'm taking command. Priority: contain first, then preserve evidence. Maria — confirm whether this SA has any active long-lived keys or service tokens.
maria (sec-oncall): Confirmed: one user-managed JSON key created ~5m ago. Also several short-lived OIDC tokens observed. No known recent deploys referencing this SA.
emma (containment): On it. Plan: 1) disable JSON key, 2) rotate any attached secrets, 3) apply egress block for workloads using SA. I'll run commands now.
emma (containment): Running: 
```
# GCP
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=redwood-data-proc@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# disable key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable 0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8i9j --iam-account=redwood-data-proc@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
security-bot: key disable logged: 0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8i9j disabled by emma at 1794501301
alex (incident-cmdr): Good. Li — start forensic capture: snapshot of the instance(s) that used the SA, and export relevant audit logs (IAM, storage, VPC). Preserve timestamps.
li (forensics): Starting snapshot job. Capturing: /var/log/*, docker daemon logs, recent process list, network connections. Exporting: audit-logs (last 48h) to secure bucket rs-internal-forensics (immutable). ETA ~12m.
jonathan (scribe): Timeline note 1794501234: first alert. 1794501301: JSON key disabled. 1794501320: egress rule applied to svc cluster-a.
sara (comms): Drafting internal comms for affected teams. Will mention data export investigation and that we rotated credentials. Notifying compliance and legal.
alex (incident-cmdr): Who has permissions to rotate KMS-wrapped secrets for that SA? We need to ensure no remaining credentials are valid anywhere.
maria (sec-oncall): @devops-bot running a query for secrets referencing that SA across vault and params.
devops-bot: Found references in: terraform module 'data-ingest' (staging), k8s secret 'ingest-svc' in cluster-a (mounted by job-runner). Also an old Jenkins job.
emma (containment): I'm revoking k8s secret, scaling down job-runner to 0 for cluster-a, and disabling Jenkins job. Commands: 
```
kubectl -n data delete secret ingest-svc --context=cluster-a
kubectl -n data scale deployment job-runner --replicas=0 --context=cluster-a
# Jenkins disable
curl -u ci-user:*** -X POST https://jenkins.internal/job/data-ingest/disable
```
li (forensics): Noted. Imaging job-runner pod filesystem before scale down for artifact preservation.
jonathan (scribe): Evidence saved: gs://rs-internal-forensics/1794501234/image-job-runner.tar.gz
alex (incident-cmdr): Any signs of exfil completed? Size of recent exports?
maria (sec-oncall): We see dataset export events to external bucket s3://redwood-outbound-exports with 2 files ~2.1GB total around 1794501208. Need to confirm contents.
ali? (typo)
li (forensics): Downloading exported files to walled environment for inspection. Hashes: sha256: f1d2d2f924e986ac86fdf7b36c94bcdf32... (truncated).
sara (comms): External comms hold: inform impacted product leads + compliance. Avoid public messaging until we know scope.
emma (containment): Applied network egress deny-list for SA's service account tokens and added firewall rule BLOCK_EGRESS_SA_REDWOOD_DATA_PROC. Propagated.
alex (incident-cmdr): Risk assessment: potential data exposure (medium). Elevate to P1 SEV if export contents include PII. Legal on standby. 
jonathan (scribe): Adding action items: 1) finish file inspection (li), 2) confirm list of systems with SA access (maria/devops-bot), 3) rotate any remaining credentials (emma), 4) timeline & internal comms (sara).
li (forensics): File inspection: preliminary — files contain anonymized telemetry and one tokenized customer id list. No clear PII found in first-pass. Will complete full review in 45m.
maria (sec-oncall): Running IAM audit query to enumerate principals bound to roles for that SA across org, will produce playbook to remove bindings.
alex (incident-cmdr): If no PII, still treat as breach due to unauthorized export. We will continue containment and then run post-incident RBAC hardening: require short-lived keys only, restrict SA to minimal roles, and add alerting for token creation > 5/hr.
sara (comms): Preparing internal incident memo and a brief for leadership. Will include current status and action items.
alex (incident-cmdr): Handoff in 4h to night oncall @jonathan. Current commander: alex. Scribe: jonathan. Containment lead: emma. Forensics: li. Comms: sara. Security lead: maria. Legal: on-call counsel paged.
jonathan (scribe): Handoff checklist to night shift: summary, keys disabled, evidence locations, egress block in place, list of systems touched, outstanding: full file inspection, IAM binding removal, rotate KMS-wrapped creds in terraform.
emma (containment): Before I handoff, I'll ensure Jenkins job is archived and secret stores updated. Will drop final confirmation in thread.
li (forensics): Uploading full hashes and inspection notes to rs-internal-forensics/1794501234/forensics-notes.md
security-bot: Incident A-2026-892 status updated: CONTAINED -> in_progress at 1794504000 by alex
alex (incident-cmdr): Closing loop for this shift: containment stable, no active tokens remaining, forensics ongoing. Handoff complete. Night oncall please escalate to leadership if inspection finds PII.
jonathan (scribe): 1794505378: Handoff accepted by jonathan. Logging handoff summary and moving to follow-up runbook. :white_check_mark:
